curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What begins as an impulsive childhood joy ride quickly turns lethal once the cruiser's dangerous owner realizes it is missing.
curatedMovie.description: After stumbling upon an abandoned police cruiser and taking it for a reckless joy ride, two kids trigger a deadly, high-stakes game of cat and mouse with a ruthless sheriff in director Jon Watts's compact crime thriller.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A fast, taut crime thriller that delivers sharp suspense and engaged focus without unnecessary weight.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Clocking in at a lean 88 minutes, this fast, suspenseful pursuit strips the thriller formula down to its bare essentials with unrelenting momentum and constant tension.
